data.name: That Special Someone
data.headline: Private Charter • Up to 6 People
data.description:
# A romantic sailing experience for you and the one you love.

## Duration
2 Hours

## About
- Popping the question? This package is ideal for proposals and engagements.
- Connect with the person you love like never before. Sailing is the perfect date on the water.
- We will take care of everything you'll need to make this occasion perfectly romantic. All you have to do is show up..and not drop the ring in the water.
- Breathtaking views during sunset, The San Diego Skyline, or sail out to the ocean.
- Option to sail wherever you want.
- Option to arrange for a photographer to be on board for an additional fee.
- Option to arrange for a photographer to arrive by boat while capturing the moment for an additional fee. They will board our boat after for professional photos.
- Option to upgrade the flower bouquet.

highlight_box.title: Proposal Package
highlight_box.description: Flowers, Rose pedals, champagne, photos, and chocolate covered strawberries included.

data.highlights: The combination of a private sailing yacht in one of the most beautiful cities in the world, being with the person you love, the food, the flowers, the photos, and the celebration champagne are what makes this trip so special.
data.itinerary:
1. Arrive 15 minutes prior to departure.
2. Leave the slip, put up the sails.
3. For engagements, the captain would advice that you propose 30 minutes into the charter. This provides time to celebrate and take photos. This is just advice. For engagements during golden hour book approximately 1 hr prior to whatever time the sunset is on that day.
4. Sail in the San Diego Bay.
5. Return to the slip.

meeting_point.address: 1880 Harbor Island Dr San Diego, CA US 92101

data.what_is_included:
## Included
- Additional bottle of champagne, rose bouquet, rose pedals, and chocolate covered strawberries. 
- Photos/video included by a crew member. Ask about hiring a photogographer if you would like reccomendations.
- Soda, water, champagne, and snacks are available (gluten-free and vegan snack options).
- There is a refrigerator, a restroom, and a JBL Party Box Speaker with karaoke on board. 
- There are plates, cups, hand sanitizer, and bottle openers available for use.
data.cancellation_notes: Customers will receive a full refund or credit with 48 hours notice of cancellation. Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. Contact us by phone to cancel or inquire about a cancellation. No-shows will be charged the full price.
